title: Count of satisfying sign replacement clauses
statement: Let $b\in\{-1,1\}$ and let $(v_0,v_1,v_2)\in\{-1,1\}^3$. Form four clauses indexed by the four even-parity sign triples $e\in\{-1,1\}^3$, whose coordinate product is $+1$. In the clause indexed by $e$, the falsifying triple is $e$ with its first coordinate multiplied by $-b$; the clause is satisfied unless the input triple equals that falsifying triple. The number of these clauses satisfied by $(v_0,v_1,v_2)$ is $3$ plus $1$ if $v_0v_1v_2=b$, and is $3$ otherwise.
